Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 99.06 is moderate. SOFR measures secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions. These are dated observations, not live quotes.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • The 8:30 AM ET cluster is PPI, Initial Claims, Census advance retail sales, Empire State, Philadelphia Fed manufacturing, and the Chicago Fed NFCI. The New York Fed calendar is the date/time authority for the BLS PPI and claims rows; no BLS site was accessed.
  • Weekly H.4.1 is scheduled today at 4:30 PM ET. Chairman Kevin Warsh's listed Bangkok discussion is at 11:30 PM ET today. The week-ahead table includes selected Fed releases, not every daily CP/H.15 release.
  • The next FOMC meeting listed on the Board's October calendar is October 27-28, outside this Oct 15-22 week-ahead window. The Board calendar lists the press conference at 2:30 PM ET on Oct 28.
  • October 15 Treasury bill cutoffs are verified at 11:30 AM ET for 4- and 8-week bills. The EIA petroleum report is scheduled for noon; its schedule reflects the Columbus Day-adjusted publication date.
  • Calendar scope is selected events from the New York Fed October indicators calendar, Federal Reserve Board October calendar, Census 2026 calendar, Chicago Fed release calendar, Philadelphia Fed survey page, TreasuryDirect, EIA, BEA, and NAR. No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: the New York Fed calendar lists CPI on Wed Oct 14 at 8:30 AM ET, already before this cutoff. The Beige Book was also dated Oct 14, but the Federal Reserve Board calendar says 2:00 PM ET while Chicago Fed says 3:00 PM ET. That time conflict remains unresolved; both are elapsed, so neither appears as a future row.
  • BLS pages are not requested because the host refuses access; BLS CPI/PPI, claims and import/export timing is sourced from the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar. CPI is elapsed; PPI is today at 8:30 AM ET. No release period is asserted where the checked calendar does not state one.
  • Chicago Fed NFCI data returned only through the week ending Oct 2 (-0.494; prior Sep 25 -0.510). The Oct 9 NFCI release is scheduled for 8:30 AM today, after the cutoff; no unreleased value is inferred.
  • EIA natural-gas schedule checked but no date-specific Oct 15-22 release entry was verified; no event is inferred from its usual cadence. BEA schedule checked: no release in this date window; it lists GDP for Oct 29 and Personal Income and Outlays for Nov 4.
  • TreasuryDirect shows the Oct 19 13- and 26-week bill auctions, Oct 20 6-week bill auction, and Oct 21 20-year bond reopening; the currently posted records have no cutoff time or offering amount for these, so they are date-only. Today's 4- and 8-week cutoffs and amounts are posted.
  • The week-ahead list is selected, not exhaustive. Less market-sensitive Board statistical rows, including daily Commercial Paper and H.15 dates, are omitted; their omission does not mean the checked calendars have no other entries. NAR confirms the next Existing-Home Sales release is Nov 12, not within this window.
  • Data sources checked: New York Fed SOFR and October Economic Indicators Calendar; Chicago Fed NFCI CSV and release calendar; U.S. Treasury curve; TreasuryDirect auctions; Federal Reserve Board October calendar and H.4.1; Census 2026 calendar; Philadelphia Fed manufacturing calendar; EIA petroleum and natural-gas schedules; BEA schedule; NAR release schedules; and Yahoo Finance chart quotes. Market quotes are single-source vendor observations. Generic ES=F is not contract-bound; verify live quotes, contract, hours, depth, and event updates before execution.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Treat the 12:20 AM ET generic ES=F quote as overnight context only. MOVE is in the moderate band and the latest official 10Y close is 5.19%. The 8:30 AM release cluster and noon EIA report are scheduled volatility checkpoints; allow for price discovery rather than assuming a direction. Scenario framework only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess any scenario if ES sustains a range break with confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility, and market depth, or if the active contract's hours differ. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied; reconfirm live quotes and event updates before execution.
